CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Content is how they succeed. This role owns that content.

You own the self-service content engine: the knowledge base customers search and the library of configuration guides our automated campaigns deliver to the right account at the right moment. You write for developers, you prioritize from support ticket and engagement data, and you measure whether your content deflects tickets and moves product adoption. You work directly with the Director and the team's program manager.

- The knowledge base backlog, ranked by ticket volume and category. You close the gaps customers hit most and retire stale articles

- The play library: setup guides, configuration walkthroughs, and feature adoption content that our automated campaigns send based on each account's configuration

- Lifecycle email content: onboarding sequences, save flows, and win-back tracks, written with the success program manager

- Content performance: click-through from campaigns, ticket deflection by category, and adoption movement measured against control groups

- The docs workflow: markdown, git, and review cycles, kept clean enough that anyone can contribute

- Rank the knowledge base backlog by ticket data and ship the top gaps

- Deliver the launch content for the first automated campaign cycles

- Stand up the content performance readout: clicks, deflection, and adoption movement, reported on the team's measurement cadence

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 3+ years of technical writing or developer enablement for a developer-facing product

- You can read a configuration file, run the setup flow yourself, and write the guide from your own hands-on experience

- You work in docs-as-code: markdown, git, and review cycles are your normal workflow

- You prioritize from data: support tickets, search queries, and click behavior tell you what to write next

- You measure what you publish and rewrite or retire what underperforms

NICE TO HAVE

- You have written for code review, CI/CD, or developer tooling audiences

- Lifecycle email experience on a marketing automation platform

- Familiar with AI tooling and examples of you using it for similar roles.

- Short-form video or interactive tutorial production

HOW WE WORK

The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit.

Prescryptive is the healthcare technology company enabling the direct access marketplace for prescription drugs. Our platform aligns incentives so affordability, choice, and patient access become the natural outcome of a functioning system.
We operate one of the few platforms in healthcare that functions as both an ePrescription network and an adjudication engine - neutral infrastructure that pharmaceutical manufacturers, PBMs, health systems, and pharmacies can build on. About the Role
We are hiring a Director, Product Management - Direct-to-Patient Pharmacy Platform to own the product strategy and roadmap for Prescryptive’s Direct-to-Patient platform.
This is a senior individual contributor product leadership role for someone who understands how prescriptions actually move through the U.S. healthcare system - from prescriber initiation to ePrescription routing, benefit verification, adjudication, pharmacy fulfillment, and patient access.

You will report to the SVP of Digital Prescription Services and work regularly with manufacturer partners, pharmacy networks, integration partners, and Prescryptive’s executive leadership team.

Pharmaceutical access is changing quickly. Manufacturers are looking for new ways to connect patients to therapy, reduce friction, improve affordability, and create more direct, data-informed access models.
Prescryptive is building the infrastructure to support that shift.
In this role, you will help define a platform category - not simply optimize an existing workflow. You will work on a live platform already processing tens of thousands of prescription transactions daily, with direct exposure to senior commercial and manufacturer stakeholders.
The right person will have the opportunity to shape how Direct-to-Patient prescription access works across manufacturers, pharmacies, prescribers, and patients.

You will focus on two areas: leading complex, ambiguous, high-impact UX research that informs product strategy, and building a scalable UX Research practice within the Design team . Designers will run simpler studies independently, while you provide the process, coaching, quality guardrails, and support that make research a consistent habit.

• Run your work independently: access to tools/data, participant scheduling and confirmations, session logistics, note-taking, and documentation - no hand-holding.

• Work closely with Product Analytics to connect quantitative and qualitative evidence. We work together and show a product manager a full picture of user behavior.

• Experiment with new approaches and tools, from moderated and unmoderated testing to emerging AI-enabled methods such as synthetic users, where they can add real value.

• Be the user's best friend: ensure user needs and constraints are represented in product decisions - not just opinions.
